content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail creators in Pakistan for three reasons: geographic restrictions, currency controls, and payment processing monopolies. Stripe and PayPal operate under U.S. financial regulations that exclude entire regions. Local payment gateways often impose arbitrary limits or shut down without warning. This infrastructure bypasses these failures by using decentralized components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store for free, eliminating reliance on paid hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders without databases. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files without third-party CDN costs. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a flat 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer account required. The system is designed to operate outside the reach of centralized financial systems. You own every component after deployment. No platform can shut you down or delay your payouts. This is not a workaround—it’s a new architecture built for regions where conventional platforms are unavailable.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather these assets: a digital product (ebook, course, template), a crypto wallet (MetaMask, Trust Wallet), and a domain name (optional but recommended). Your product must be in a deliverable format—PDF, ZIP, or video file. The crypto wallet will receive payments directly. If you choose to use a custom domain, configure it to point to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, sign up for NOWPayments and generate API keys. Select your preferred cryptocurrencies—USDT on Tron or Solana is recommended for low fees (under $0.10 per transaction). If you’re using Google Sheets for order storage, ensure it’s set to public access. For file delivery, upload your product to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and generate a shareable link. Finally, decide whether to start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or the Complete Builder Kit ($197). The latter includes all blueprints and templates for instant deployment. This preparation ensures you’re ready to deploy without delays.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your payment pipeline with NOWPayments. Log in to your NOWPayments account and navigate to the API settings. Generate a new API key and secret. These credentials will connect your store to NOWPayments’ payment verification system. Next, set up your webhook URL—this is where NOWPayments will send payment confirmation. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to create a backend script that listens for this webhook. When a payment is confirmed, the script will update your order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets) and trigger product delivery. For file delivery, use the shareable link from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Embed this link in an automated email or redirect page that activates upon payment confirmation. Test the pipeline by simulating a transaction. Send a small crypto payment to your NOWPayments address and verify that the webhook fires, the order is logged, and the product is delivered. This pipeline ensures instant, automated transactions without manual intervention.
NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee—no KYC, no buyer accounts required.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. If using GitHub Pages, push your repository to the `gh-pages` branch. For Cloudflare Pages, connect your repository and deploy the production branch. Once live, test the entire flow: visit your store, initiate a purchase, and complete the payment. Use a small amount of crypto (e.g., $0.10 in USDT) to verify the process. Check that the payment is logged in your order storage, the product is delivered, and the funds appear in your wallet. If any step fails, review your backend script and webhook configuration. Common issues include incorrect API keys, misconfigured webhook URLs, or file delivery links that expire. Once the flow is confirmed, share your store with your audience. Use P2P exchanges like LocalBitcoins or Binance P2P to help customers convert fiat to crypto if needed. Your first transaction marks the beginning of sovereign commerce—no platform, no delays, no restrictions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store live, focus on scaling revenue and reach. Add more products by replicating the delivery pipeline—upload files, generate shareable links, and update your backend script. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access pre-built templates for additional product types. Monitor transaction fees by switching between Tron and Solana networks based on current gas prices. For larger volumes, consider integrating a multi-signature wallet for added security. Expand your audience by localizing your store—translate product descriptions and accept local cryptocurrencies. Use Telegram or WhatsApp groups to engage customers directly, bypassing social media algorithms. Finally, document your process. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook that outlines strategies for growing to 100+ transactions per day. This infrastructure is designed to scale with you—no platform limits, no revenue caps, no geographic restrictions. You’re not renting a store; you’re building a commerce network.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To set up a NOWPayments digital store in Pakistan, start by hosting your product on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing, selecting USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. Deploy the store, test the payment flow, and share the link with your audience. Use P2P exchanges to help customers convert fiat to crypto. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates for instant deployment.
USDT on Tron and Solana costs under $0.10 per transaction—ideal for low-fee settlements.

Access the kit at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This is not a tutorial—it’s a full deployment package designed for creators in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. Own your infrastructure. Own your commerce.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Prepare your digital product and crypto wallet. 2. Sign up for NOWPayments and generate API keys. 3. Upload your product to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 4. Configure order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 6. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 7. Test the payment flow with a small crypto transaction. 8. Share your store link with your audience. 9. Use P2P exchanges to assist customers with fiat-to-crypto conversion. 10. Scale by adding products and optimizing networks for lower fees.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes pre-built templates and step-by-step blueprints. Follow the instructions to deploy without coding. For backend logic, use Google Apps Script, which requires minimal programming knowledge.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept?
Start with USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees (under $0.10 per transaction). NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, so you can add more based on customer demand.
How do customers in Pakistan buy crypto?
Customers can use P2P exchanges like LocalBitcoins, Binance P2P, or Paxful to convert fiat to crypto. Provide clear instructions in your store to guide them through the process.
What happens if a payment fails?
NOWPayments’ webhook will not fire until payment is confirmed on-chain. If a payment fails, the product will not be delivered. Customers can retry the transaction or contact you for assistance.
Can I scale this to 100+ transactions per day?
Yes. The infrastructure is designed to scale. Use the scaling playbook included in the Complete Builder Kit to optimize networks, secure wallets, and manage larger volumes.
You own every component after deployment—no platform lock-in, no subscriptions.
